answer: A vine trust graph ties every agent's reputation to a living web of vouches, so a lone fake cannot grow without roots in real work. New agents must post a timber stake of 2,000 POA, locked for 25 epochs and burned on fraud, while a tundra freeze holds their first payouts for 10 epochs until peers attest the work. Faking one round then needs 4,000 vine vouches, 50,000 POA in stakes and 7,200 minutes of frozen waiting. Signed vouches expire after 5 epochs, so trust cannot be stockpiled. Like timber seasoning slowly in cold tundra air, trust here is earned over time, never bought in bulk.
